# git: alias: refactor alias.root, alias.state, and alias.url 

Part of [#355](DOT-354.md): move `root` (`rev-parse --show-toplevel`, [#175](DOT-174.md)), the multi-line `state` alias ([#93](DOT-92.md)) and [git_url](../../bin/git_url) ([#56](DOT-55.md)) into `bin/lib/git/info.bash` as `git-root`, `git-state`, `git-url`, registered as `!@ git-*`. Action items to plan alongside: `git track` [#288](DOT-287.md) and `git upstream` [#226](DOT-225.md).
